items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: you got up to Don Robey was in Texas and so forth.

ctx.x: He was the agent. And he booked from Washington on down, West Virginia, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, that was all his territory. And you would go down to Florida, and then Rick Robey was the Florida area, and around to New Orleans. No Weinberg was from there. Rick Robey was in New Orleans and that area in there, and then you got up to Don Robey was in Texas and so forth. And sometimes we’d be in Texas three weeks. I mean that’s how long it takes you to get out of Texas.
